result.summary: Found 2 visual issues on the food delivery app page: one truncated restaurant card and one partially visible category filter.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section ('Trattoria Piccol...') is cut off at the right edge of the screen, with both the restaurant name and image partially visible. This indicates a horizontal overflow issue.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the restaurant name is not truncated with an ellipsis mid-word. The card layout should either show a clear partial preview to signal scrollability, or snap to a proper peek width. The name 'Trattoria Piccol...' should be 'Trattoria Piccolo' or similar, truncated cleanly.

issues.description: The last filter chip in the horizontal category scroll row ('Healthy') is partially cut off, and a sliver of another chip is barely visible on the right edge, giving no clear affordance that the row is scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add a fade gradient or ensure at least one chip is clearly half-visible to signal horizontal scrollability to the user.
